bullets.text: Activities per advisor reached 10.0 this week, up 2.6% from 9.8 last week and above the trailing 13-week average of 9.9. The prior week had been down 2.5%.
Outbound calls rose 20.8% to 29.0 and appointments booked rose 83.3% to 11.0. Call-to-appointment rate was 27.6%, ahead of the 24.3% trailing average.
Show rate fell to 42.9% from 62.5%, below the 57.3% trailing average. No-show rate rose to 57.1%.
13-week coverage rose to 85.5% from 70.9%. Clients contacted slipped 3.6% to 27.0, and average meeting length fell 6.3% to 57.0 minutes.
MTL, the only child node, matches QC on activities per advisor at 10.0, show rate at 42.9% and coverage at 85.5%.

answer.headline: QC activities per advisor rose 2.6% this week to 10.0, up from 9.8 the prior week.
